results.name: squad_update_all
results.evidence: Walks squad datums via data_iterator_next() filtering the per-squad +0xd active flag, every 30 ticks calls squad_recalculate_dirty/squad_update_activation_all, and on a staggered schedule (index%15==tick%15) calls the squad morale/decay/spawn/target subroutines.
results.summary: Per-tick top-level dispatcher that iterates live squads and, on a staggered schedule, invokes each squad's morale, timer-decay, reinforcement, and target-selection update routines.

results.name: squad_recalculate_dirty
results.evidence: Iterates squad datums via data_iterator_next() and calls FUN_00437940 (squad_update_morale_and_combat_status) only for squads whose +0x28 byte ('dirty') flag is set.
results.summary: Scans all squads and re-runs the morale/combat-status recompute routine for any squad flagged dirty since the last pass.

results.name: squad_count_unmatched_actors
results.evidence: For a squad whose starting-location field +0xb8 is set, iterates the global actor list comparing each actor's label (+2) to it (either exact match or via a 10x10 bit-table lookup at DAT_006b0b84+0xa4) and increments a counter (+0x4c) on actors that fail the match and carry flags +0x42/+0x43/+0x47.
results.summary: Counts actors whose assigned label/zone does not match a given squad's target label, tallying the mismatch count on each unmatched actor.

results.name: squad_build_zone_occupant_table
results.evidence: Zero-fills an output buffer sized from the squad tag's adjacency-list count (+0x98), then walks the squad's actor linked list (head +0x14, next +0x2c) writing each actor's id into a slot indexed by its zone-membership field (+0x3b8).
results.summary: Builds a lookup table mapping each connected zone/cluster index to the actor id currently occupying it for a given squad.

results.name: squad_compute_zone_activation_mask
results.evidence: Walks a squad's actor list, resolves each actor's unit-group leader via the +0x11c 'next in group' chain, reads the leader's zone id at +0x9c and sets the matching bit in the caller-supplied bitmask; also expands the mask through the squad tag's adjacency tables (+0x98/+0x9c and +0x80/+0x84) and can record a per-actor visibility flag at +0x12.
results.summary: Computes (and optionally records per-actor) the set of BSP zones/clusters that a squad's living actors currently occupy, expanded through door/portal adjacency tables.

results.name: squad_remove_actor
results.evidence: Searches the squad's actor linked list (head at squad+0x14, next at actor+0x2c) for the entry matching the actor index, unlinks it, decrements the squad's per-state (DAT_008802cc) and per-type (DAT_008802c4) occupancy counters, resets the actor's list fields to -1, and sets the squad's dirty flag (+0x28).
results.summary: Unlinks an actor from its squad's member list and updates the squad's per-state/per-type occupancy counters.

results.name: squad_assign_label_from_unit
results.evidence: When not on easy difficulty (DAT_006f1d20==0) and the squad's runtime label field (+2) is unset, copies the given unit's tag field +0xb8 into it, then calls FUN_0042bbb0 if the squad already has an actor list (+0x14 != -1).
results.summary: Lazily stamps a squad's label from a unit's tag data the first time the squad is populated.

results.name: squad_add_actor
results.evidence: Inserts an actor at the head of the squad's member list (squad+0x14), records its starting-location index (+0x3a) and derived type index (+0x3c) clipped against the starting-location count, sets a grace timer (+0xe=0x96), calls squad_activate or actor placement/activation helpers, and increments the squad's per-state/per-type occupancy counters before marking the squad dirty (+0x28).
results.summary: Registers a newly spawned actor as a member of a squad, recording its starting-location/type and updating the squad's occupancy counters.

results.name: actor_add_to_unassigned_list
results.evidence: Pushes the current actor onto the head of the global 'no squad' list (DAT_00880354+8), marks the actor's 'in list' flag (+9), computes a wait timer at +0x10, then calls FUN_00428650.
results.summary: Links an actor into the global list of actors that are not currently assigned to any squad.

results.name: actor_remove_from_unassigned_list
results.evidence: Scans the singly-linked list rooted at DAT_00880354+8 (next pointer at actor+0x2c) for the predecessor of the current actor, relinks around it, and clears its 'in list' flag (+9) and wait field (+10).
results.summary: Removes an actor from the global list of squad-less actors.

results.name: squad_actor_list_iterator_init
results.evidence: Writes a 3-field {squad_index, prev=-1, head} record into the caller's buffer, using the global unassigned-actor list head (DAT_00880354+8) when the squad index is -1, otherwise the squad's own member-list head (+0x14).
results.summary: Initializes a lightweight removal-safe iterator over one squad's actor member list (or the global unassigned list).

results.name: actor_iterator_new
results.evidence: Initializes a fixed-layout context (base pointer, salted magic 0x69746572 at +0xc, 'started' flag at +0x10, filter flag at +0x11 from param_1, sentinels -1 at +0x14/+0x18) whose fields are exactly those consumed by actor_iterator_next (FUN_00436a70).
results.summary: Constructs the iterator context used to walk every actor across all squads (and the unassigned pool), optionally filtering to only active actors.

results.name: actor_iterator_next
results.evidence: Reads the +0x10/+0x11/+0x14/+0x18 fields written by actor_iterator_new; pulls squads via data_iterator_next() to get each squad's member-list head, falls back once to the global unassigned list (DAT_00880354+8), then walks the 0x724-byte actor array via the +0x2c 'next' link, optionally skipping actors whose +8/+0xd flags say inactive.
results.summary: Advances a global actor iterator, yielding the next actor across all squads and the unassigned pool.

results.name: squad_recent_object_record
results.evidence: Obtains a per-type record via squad_recent_object_get_or_create, scans its 6-slot ring buffer (+0xc..) for an existing match to in_EDX, and if absent stores it at the ring index (+0xa, mod 6), bumping the count (+8) and stamping the current game time (+4 from DAT_006f1d6c+0xc).
results.summary: Records an object id into a squad's per-type 'recently seen' ring buffer, returning whether it was newly added.

results.name: squad_recent_object_query
results.evidence: Uses squad_recent_object_get_or_create to look up a per-type record, then scans its up-to-6 recorded ids for unaff_EBX, treating a record with count>=7 as an automatic match; outputs the record's count and last-update timestamp via param_2/param_3.
results.summary: Checks whether a given object id is present in a squad's 'recently seen' list for a type, also returning the record's count and timestamp.

results.name: squad_recent_object_list_clear
results.evidence: Walks the linked list of 'recent object' datums rooted at squad+0x38 (next pointer at +0x24) and calls datum_delete on each.
results.summary: Destroys all of a squad's 'recently seen object' tracking records.

results.name: squad_recent_object_get_or_create
results.evidence: Searches the squad's recent-object linked list (head +0x38, next +0x24) for a record whose type field (+2) matches param_1; allocates one via datum_new and links it in when missing, or resets it when stale (last-update older than param_2) and param_3 requests creation.
results.summary: Finds or (optionally) creates and resets a squad's per-type 'recently seen object' tracking record.

results.name: squad_get_starting_location_flags
results.evidence: Reads a starting-location's attribute bits (offset 0x28, forcing value 1 if bit 0x2 is set) and, depending on whether the resulting value is 1 or 2, writes a distinct pattern of booleans/shorts into five output parameters.
results.summary: Derives a set of placement-rule output flags for an actor starting location based on its tag attribute bits.

results.name: squad_evaluate_reinforcement_needs
results.evidence: Walks the squad's actor list counting members in specific activity states (fields +0x6c==5/7, +0xa4, +0x6e) matching param_3, calls FUN_0040e540 to get per-actor counts, and derives several boolean output flags plus a type-dependent threshold from param_2 (1->0, 2->999, else count/3 clamped >=3).
results.summary: Evaluates a squad's current combat-state counts to produce boolean flags describing whether it needs reinforcement or additional support.

results.name: squad_init_starting_location_exclusion_mask
results.evidence: Clears a bitmask sized from the starting-location's 0xd0 count field, then sets a bit for each child record (stride 0x1c at +0xd4) whose flag byte (+0x13) has bit 0 set.
results.summary: Builds a per-starting-location exclusion bitmask from a list of flagged sub-records (used for the squad's per-state placement bookkeeping).

results.name: squad_create
results.evidence: Calls datum_new() to allocate a squad runtime record, copies flag bits from the squad tag definition (offset 0x24 -> +0x40/+0x41/+0x3c), then initializes per-state sub-records (looping squad_init_starting_location_exclusion_mask) and per-type sub-records from the tag data.
results.summary: Allocates and initializes a new squad runtime datum from its tag definition, setting up its per-state and per-type sub-records.

results.name: squad_pick_random_starting_location
results.evidence: Operates on a per-state record's trailing bitmask (sized from the starting-location count at +0xd0), counting unused slots, picking one uniformly via the DAT_00719cd0 LCG, clearing its 'used' bit, and resetting/re-scanning the whole mask once all slots are exhausted.
results.summary: Randomly selects an as-yet-unused starting location within a squad's state bucket, recycling the pool once every location has been used.

results.name: squad_get_zone_activity_type
results.evidence: Validates a zone index (in_ECX+0x20) against DAT_00746f8c+0x420, resolves it through two levels of indirection (DAT_00746f8c+0x424, then DAT_0087bc14) to fetch a stored short value, defaulting to 0xe when any lookup fails.
results.summary: Resolves the activity/behavior type associated with a squad's assigned zone, defaulting to a fallback type when unresolved.

results.name: squad_spawn_actors_at_starting_locations
results.evidence: Iterates the squad tag's starting-location array (+0x80 count, +0x84 array), selects a difficulty-scaled spawn count via DAT_006b0b80's switch, calls squad_get_zone_activity_type, computes a spawn chance for activity type 7, then repeatedly calls squad_spawn_actor_at_location before finishing with squad_update_morale_and_combat_status/squad_update_activation_all.
results.summary: Spawns the actors for a squad's starting locations, scaling counts by difficulty and rolling per-location spawn chances for certain zone activity types.

results.name: squad_activate
results.evidence: Guarded by the squad's activation flag (+0xd), iterates the squad's member (or unassigned) actor list creating swarms (actor_create_swarm) and marking units active (actor_set_units_active) for any member not yet flagged +8, then stamps the squad's activation time (+0x10) and sets +0xd.
results.summary: Brings a squad's actors to life, spawning swarms and marking units active, and records the squad as activated.

results.name: squad_zone_history_add
results.evidence: Maintains a small fixed-size (3-entry) array at squad+0x22 with a count at +0x20, adding unaff_SI if it is not already present and the array is not yet full.
results.summary: Records a zone id into a squad's small recent-zone history list if it isn't already present and there is room.

results.name: squad_deactivate
results.evidence: Clears the squad's activation flag (+0xd), calls squad_recent_object_list_clear, then for each currently active member (flag +8) calls FUN_00427e00, actor_delete_swarm, actor_set_units_active, clears the flag, and stamps the deactivation time (+0xc) from DAT_006f1d6c.
results.summary: Deactivates a squad, deleting swarms and marking units inactive for every currently active member.

results.name: squad_update_morale_and_combat_status
results.evidence: Resets and recomputes per-state/per-type morale accumulators (DAT_008802cc/DAT_008802c4) by walking the squad's actor list, tracks damage/retreat trigger booleans against thresholds (0x3b/0x1c1) on fields +0x50/+0x54/+0x1a, and dispatches to squad_evaluate_retreat_destinations or squad_release_actor_group_links depending on the outcome.
results.summary: Recomputes a squad's aggregate morale/combat statistics from its members and decides whether the squad should begin retreating or disperse its actor-group links.

results.name: squad_update_activation_all
results.evidence: First loop walks the global actor list computing a visibility flag (+0x12) via squad_compute_zone_activation_mask and toggles swarm/active state with hysteresis timers; second loop walks all squads via data_iterator_next(), checking BSP-cluster relevance, dependent-squad activity (fields +0x20/+0x22 referencing DAT_008802c8), and calling squad_activate/squad_deactivate accordingly.
results.summary: Master per-tick pass that updates every actor's cluster-visibility/active state and decides which squads should be activated or deactivated based on player-relevant BSP clusters and dependent squads.

results.name: squad_release_actor_group_links
results.evidence: Walks the squad's actor list; for each actor referencing a group record (0x138-byte datum in DAT_008802c0) of type 4/5 with its flag (+0x60) set and not equal to the squad's own group reference (+0x270), clears the cross-link, calls actor_replace_object_reference and FUN_0043ea20, then datum_delete's the group record.
results.summary: Detaches and frees stale shared-group references held by a squad's actors (e.g. vehicle/target groupings no longer relevant to this squad).

results.name: sorted_candidate_list_insert_top2
results.evidence: Maintains a fixed 2-slot array of {id, key, extra, extra} records, shifting the existing entry down and inserting the new one in ascending order of the key value (param_3), used from squad_evaluate_retreat_destinations.
results.summary: Inserts a scored candidate into a 2-element sorted (ascending) list of best candidates.

results.name: weighted_random_select_from_candidates
results.evidence: Sums the positive weight field (+4) across up to 4 candidate slots (0x20 bytes each, id at +0), then uses the DAT_00719cd0 LCG to pick one index proportionally to its weight and copies that slot into the output parameter.
results.summary: Selects one of up to four weighted candidate records at random, proportionally to their weight values.

results.name: squad_evaluate_retreat_destinations
results.evidence: Iterates the squad's actor-group target list (DAT_008802c0 datums) scoring candidate 'safety' values from distance, threat, and combat-mode factors, tracks the best candidates via sorted_candidate_list_insert_top2, and picks among them with weighted_random_select_from_candidates; called only from squad_update_morale_and_combat_status's retreat-trigger branch.
results.summary: Scores nearby positions/targets to choose a retreat or regroup destination for a squad under morale pressure.

results.name: squad_update_grenade_timers
results.evidence: Increments squad fields +0x50/+0x54 by a fixed step (0xf) each call unless their associated flags (+0x44/+0x45) are set (in which case they reset to 0), and separately decrements a countdown at +0x4a by 0xf when both +0x47 and +0x48 are set.
results.summary: Advances or resets a squad's grenade-related cooldown timers each tick based on its current combat flags.

results.name: squad_spawn_actor_at_location
results.evidence: Resolves a starting-location's mapped vehicle/placement index via squad_pick_random_starting_location, chases a tag-index indirection through DAT_00746f8c/DAT_0087bc14, optionally calls FUN_0042a950, then calls actor_place_new_unit with the resolved object type, squad index, and location.
results.summary: Spawns a single actor unit for a squad at a resolved starting location, mapping the location to its placed object type first.

results.name: squad_spawn_actor_and_update_counts
results.evidence: Calls squad_spawn_actor_at_location and, on success, increments the squad's spawned-count (+0x2a) and per-state count (+0x18), decrements a remaining-to-spawn counter (+0xc) when positive, and assigns two random fields via FUN_006391b4.
results.summary: Spawns an actor for a squad and updates the squad's per-state spawn bookkeeping counters on success.

results.name: squad_process_reinforcements
results.evidence: Gated by squad flag +0x3c and a cooldown at +0x3e that ticks down by 0xf per call; once ready, iterates the squad's starting locations computing remaining spawn capacity per state bucket and repeatedly calls squad_spawn_actor_and_update_counts, choosing among eligible buckets with the DAT_00719cd0 LCG.
results.summary: Periodically spawns reinforcement actors for a squad into starting-location buckets that still have spawn capacity.

results.name: squad_trigger_grenade_for_state
results.evidence: Clears a per-state grenade-cooldown field (+0x12 in the DAT_008802cc record) and, if the corresponding starting-location's flag bit 0x10 is set, calls FUN_00432d90.
results.summary: Resets a squad state's grenade-throw cooldown and, for eligible starting locations, triggers the grenade-throw behavior.

results.name: squad_update_grenade_cooldowns
results.evidence: Iterates a squad's per-state records; for states with a positive cooldown (+0x12) and a starting location not flagged 'no grenades' (bit 3), either sets a ready flag (+0x11) based on an 'always'/count condition or decays the cooldown by 0xf, calling squad_trigger_grenade_for_state once it lapses.
results.summary: Decays each of a squad's per-state grenade-throw cooldowns and triggers grenade throws once they expire.

results.name: squad_update_type_flags
results.evidence: Iterates a squad's per-type records (DAT_008802c4, count at +10) with a positive member count (+6), evaluates a scripted condition via squad_evaluate_type_condition, and updates the type's boolean flag accordingly.
results.summary: Re-evaluates and updates a per-type behavior flag for each populated actor type in a squad.

results.name: squad_migrate_actors_to_nearest_target
results.evidence: Depending on the squad's follow-mode (+0x62 == 1/2/3), gathers candidate target objects (via data_iterator_next, object_try_and_get, or a FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0 search), finds nearby squads/starting locations whose zones are close to those targets, and reassigns actors between squads via squad_remove_actor/actor_remove_from_unassigned_list plus per-mode state-transition callbacks.
results.summary: Redistributes actors between squads and starting locations to keep the squad near one or more tracked target objects (e.g. players or a followed object).

results.name: squad_propagate_flags_to_actors
results.evidence: Walks the squad's actor list copying squad-level flags (+0x42, +0x60) onto each actor's runtime fields (+0x1c8, +0x1ca), conditionally resets per-actor zone fields, and for actors whose type record indicates a 'should wander' state calls FUN_004290f0/FUN_00423600 before finishing with squad_recalculate_dirty.
results.summary: Propagates squad-level combat/behavior flags down to each member actor and kicks off wander behavior where indicated.

results.name: squad_evaluate_type_condition
results.evidence: Switches on a condition-type code (1-9) to compare a morale ratio against fixed thresholds (0.75/0.5/0.25) or compare two counts with various relations (less-than, ratio, doubled, quadrupled, <2, ==0), used by squad_update_type_flags.
results.summary: Evaluates one of several scripted morale/count-based conditions used to decide a squad type's behavior flag.

results.name: path_find_set_fallback_point_far
results.evidence: Writes a flag + 3D position (from in_ECX) plus three extra parameters into a fixed record at offset +0x24 of the pathfinding context, matching the fields later read at +0x74..+0x7c in path_find_build_result_path.
results.summary: Records a secondary 'fallback' waypoint (position plus extra parameters) in the pathfinding search context.

results.name: path_find_point_within_radius
results.evidence: Computes a fractional position along the segment between two points via FUN_00502060 and reports success when the (1-t)-scaled squared distance between them is below 0.1, outputting the first point's coordinates.
results.summary: Tests whether two 3D points are effectively coincident along a computed interpolation fraction, used as a pathfinding proximity check.

results.name: path_find_try_set_goal
results.evidence: Zero-fills an output goal record then calls path_find_point_within_radius; on success copies the resulting position/flags into the goal record's fields.
results.summary: Attempts to validate and record a candidate pathfinding goal point.

results.name: path_find_get_matching_reference
results.evidence: Walks a linked list of 0x34-byte search-reference nodes (array at in_ECX+0x84, next index at +2) calling FUN_0043d9b0 to test each against param_1, falling back to a default record (in_ECX+0x14..0x1c) when no node matches.
results.summary: Finds the first pathfinding search-reference node matching a given test, or returns a default reference if none match.

results.name: path_find_compute_distance_to_goal
results.evidence: Computes straight-line distance to a target point plus a 'leash' radius term derived via path_find_closest_point_on_segment (FUN_0043b2f0), and optionally back-traces the path-so-far (via each node's parent field) to build a look-ahead direction vector normalized with vector3d_normalize_with_length.
results.summary: Computes the pathfinding heuristic distance from a search node to its goal, including an optional leash radius and look-ahead direction.

results.name: path_find_build_result_path
results.evidence: Back-traces a chain of search nodes via each node's parent index (+2 within the 0x34-byte record), collects waypoint positions into a local buffer, calls FUN_0043cc00 and FUN_0043be90 to smooth/validate it, then copies the result into the output path structure and computes its final length with vector3d_distance.
results.summary: Reconstructs and smooths the final waypoint path from a completed pathfinding search's node chain.

results.name: path_find_context_init
results.evidence: Zero-fills a large (~0x4023 dword) context buffer matching the vertex/heap/hash-table layout used by path_find_run and friends, stamps it with the current BSP generation (DAT_00746f9c) at offset 0x64, and copies caller-supplied start parameters into its header.
results.summary: Initializes a pathfinding search context, clearing its working buffers and recording the current BSP generation and start parameters.

results.name: path_find_set_fallback_point_near
results.evidence: Writes a flag + 3D position (from in_ECX) plus two extra parameters into a fixed record at offset +0x4c of the pathfinding context, matching the fields read at +0x50..+0x60 elsewhere in the search code.
results.summary: Records a primary/near 'fallback' waypoint (position plus extra parameters) in the pathfinding search context.

results.name: path_find_push_start_node
results.evidence: Allocates the first search node from the context's node pool (+0x80), fills in its position/cost fields from the context's start data (+0x14..+0x1c), registers it in the vertex hash table (+0xe08a), and calls path_find_heap_push to add it to the open list.
results.summary: Creates and pushes the initial node onto a pathfinding search's open list.

results.name: path_find_run
results.evidence: Initializes the vertex hash table and pushes the start node via path_find_push_start_node, then loops popping the cheapest node from the open-list heap, testing for goal arrival, expanding neighboring edges via path_find_get_vertex_edges, and pushing/updating successor nodes through path_find_heap_push/sift routines - the classic structure of an A*-style search.
results.summary: Runs the main A*-style pathfinding search loop over the navigation mesh, expanding nodes from a priority open list until the goal is reached or the list is exhausted.

results.name: path_find_heap_sift_up
results.evidence: Classic binary-heap sift-up: given an index, compares against its parent in the paired key/value arrays (offsets +0xd086/+0xd088) and swaps upward while the parent's key is larger, updating each moved node's back-reference (node*0x34+0xb4).
results.summary: Restores the pathfinding open-list min-heap property by sifting a newly inserted or decreased-key node upward.

results.name: path_find_heap_sift_down
results.evidence: Classic binary-heap sift-down: repeatedly compares a node against its two children in the paired arrays at +0xd086/+0xd088 and swaps with the smaller child until heap order is restored, updating back-references at node*0x34+0xb4.
results.summary: Restores the pathfinding open-list min-heap property by sifting a node downward after removal of the root.

results.name: path_find_heap_push
results.evidence: Appends a new (key, value) pair to the end of the heap arrays at +0xd084/+0xd086/+0xd088 (capped at 0x400 entries) and calls path_find_heap_sift_up to restore heap order.
results.summary: Inserts a new entry into the pathfinding open-list min-heap.

results.name: path_find_vertex_distance
results.evidence: Calls FUN_005015a0 and FUN_0044d860 (coordinate resolution/transform helpers) on the two point arguments before computing their 3D Euclidean distance.
results.summary: Computes the distance between two pathfinding vertices after resolving their coordinates through a transform step.

results.name: path_find_get_vertex_edges
results.evidence: Given a vertex/point index, walks its half-edge ring in the navigation-mesh structure (arrays at iVar4+0x40/+0x4c/+0x58) collecting up to 0x40 neighboring edges - each with its far endpoint id, a flag byte, and start/direction vectors - into the output buffer.
results.summary: Gathers the navigation-mesh edges adjacent to a given vertex for expansion during pathfinding search.

results.name: path_find_hash_lookup
results.evidence: Hashes a vertex/point id (masked to 0x1ff, shifted into an 8-probe group) into the context's +0xe08a table and linearly probes (wrapping at 0xfff) until it finds a slot whose referenced node's stored id (node*0x34+0x8c) matches, or a terminating -1.
results.summary: Looks up the existing search-node index for a given vertex id in the pathfinding context's hash table.

results.name: path_find_closest_point_on_segment
results.evidence: Standard closest-point-on-segment formula: projects a point onto the line through two endpoints, clamps the parametric t to [0,1], and returns either the clamped interpolated point or one endpoint when outside the segment.
results.summary: Computes the closest point on a line segment to a given point, clamped to the segment's extent.
